format: mono, 44.1 kHz; .ogg is Opus 32 kbps (Android 10+), .m4a is AAC 48 kbps fallback
loudness: peaks under 0 dBFS; master at about -16 LUFS in production

motif.use: end of explainers and reels; never a notification

bed.use: music bed under explainers and reels

tanpura.pluck: two detuned sawtooth (x1.003), lowpass f*6 -> f*1.6, decay 3.2 s, gain 0.045 (0.07 on low Sa)

motif.pour: white noise, bandpass Q3 sweep 2200 -> 700 Hz over 0.7 s
motif.note: triangle + sine at x2.01, re-strike after 85 ms at 45%, decay 1.4 s

status: Stand-ins generated by code. The real versions are commissioned and recorded, with rights bought out.
